canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Senan Sorel: 40-year-old man, 154 cm (very-short), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-2-light. Face: soft rectangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: one mismatched earring; a repaired cuff with bright thread; a hand-painted hem mark. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
